title: Potion of recall
description: Adds two craftable potions which teleport you to your spawn point or world spawn.
body:
Adds two potion: Origin potion and Recall potion
### Recall potion
- Teleports you to your spawn point, or world spawn if you don't have one
- Requires a lapis lazuli and a bottle to craft
- Stacks to 8
### Recall potion
- Teleports you to world spawn
- Requires an amethyst shard and a bottle to craft
- Stacks to 8
## Notes
- Potion of origin requires some setting up. /reload to get instructions on how to update the world spawn
- Join the discord server to report bugs or suggest features
